{
  "cards": [
    {
      "title": "Past Crisis Replay",
      "body": "In a replay of the 2008–09 crisis, the portfolio fell by as much as $264,672, or 40.3%, from its high point. That describes a past event, not what will happen in a future downturn. Your profile is listed as Conservative, with capacity rated 1 out of 5.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_usd",
        "crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_pct",
        "investor.risk_profile",
        "investor.capacity_1to5"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Projected Fund Fees",
      "body": "The funds' average yearly fee is 0.196%. Over 30 years, projected fees are $204,147, including $151,094 above the stated baseline. The projection assumes a 6.0% return before fees and compares against a 0.05% baseline fee.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "fees.weighted_expense_ratio_pct",
        "fees.projection[2].fees_cost_usd",
        "fees.projection[2].extra_vs_baseline_usd",
        "assumptions.fee_projection_gross_return_pct",
        "assumptions.fee_baseline_expense_ratio_pct"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Retirement Plan Estimate",
      "body": "The projected balance is $592,885–$592,885 from the cautious to strong scenarios, with a $201,987 gap to the target in each. These assume real returns after fees of 1.8%–5.8%, a 3.9% withdrawal rate, and a 15.0% flat tax reduction on pre-tax accounts. This is a planning estimate, not a guarantee.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].projected_at_retirement_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].projected_at_retirement_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].gap_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].gap_usd",
        "retirement_plan.target_nest_egg_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].net_return_pct",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].net_return_pct",
        "assumptions.withdrawal_rate_pct",
        "assumptions.pre_tax_accounts_reduced_by_pct"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "advisor_questions": [
    "How should I understand the size of the past crisis drop given my risk profile and capacity?",
    "What assumptions drive the long-term fee projection, and how should I interpret the baseline comparison?",
    "How do the retirement estimate's return, withdrawal, and tax assumptions relate to my income needs?"
  ]
}
